one_line: Cloud communications API provider (SMS, voice, video, messages, verify) for programmatic messaging and calls.
auth_notes: Most APIs (SMS, Messages) use API key + secret (Basic auth) issued in the Vonage dashboard; Voice API uses JWT. OAuth2 exists for the Account API (enterprise).
self_serve_notes: Self-serve signup grants a free trial credit balance to start; prepaid or invoice billing afterward. API keys available instantly in dashboard.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: SMS, Voice, Messages (WhatsApp/Viber/MMS), Verify, Number Insight, Numbers, Video, Conversations, Audit, Subaccounts APIs
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for delivery receipts, inbound messages, and voice events (answer, DTMF, recordings)

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP; community MCP servers for Vonage exist.
